title: Non-Abelian R-symmetry and dielectric branes
summary: We study the holographic realization of the $SO(6)_R$ R-symmetry of $\mathcal{N}=4$ super Yang-Mills with unitary gauge group. Focusing on 1/2 BPS states in the $[0,J,0]$ representation of $SO(6)_R$, it is known that depending on the scaling of $J$ with $N$, these are best described holographically in terms of gravitational waves ($J\ll N$) or D3 brane giant gravitons ($J\sim N$). These two descriptions are bridged by the dielectric effect, as the D3 giant can be regarded as a puffed-up configuration of gravitational waves.
